content.about: Malta is a small island country in the middle of the Mediterranean, south of Sicily. Its golden stone cities, harbours and forts reflect a long history of knights and sailors. Valletta, the capital, is one of the smallest capitals in the EU. Its ancient temples are among the oldest free-standing buildings on Earth.

standout.text: Malta's Ġgantija temples are older than Stonehenge and the pyramids of Giza.

didYouKnow: Malta has no rivers or lakes that flow all year.
Maltese is the only Semitic language official in the EU.
Malta was awarded the George Cross for bravery in the Second World War.
